scientific_integrity: Finite rank arithmetic is exact over integers and a stated prime modulus, with five independent integer null certificates; an additional direct graph checker tests 3,131 marked configurations. No probabilistic extrapolation substitutes for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The four-marker theorem is for alphabet size four and any dimension. The five-marker example invalidates only distance-plus-one-neighbour tomography, not all iterative colour refinement. The dimension-plus-one iteration upper bound is not claimed sharp. Bibliographic priority and the mathematics have not been independently audited.
title: Four-landmark orbit recovery and a five-landmark tomography obstruction in quaternary Hamming graphs
